title: A shop visit from start to finish

sections.title: The steps
sections.content: A visit to a shop has its own order, and you now have a phrase for each step. The assistant asks *Segíthetek?* You say what you want: *Egy inget kérek.* You give the size and colour: *Nagy kell.* You ask *Mennyibe kerül?*, choose with *Ezt veszem.* or refuse with a reason. You ask politely for the till: *Legyen szíves, hol van a pénztár?* And at the end: *Fizetni kell. Van kártyám.*

sections.title: What to say
rows: I would like a white shirt.

items.english: I would like a blue shirt.
Too expensive. I won't take it.
One has to pay. I have a card.

sections.content: Match the verb to the thing: *egy inget kérek* (any shirt), *ezt veszem* (this one). With a stranger say *Ön*, *Legyen szíves* and *uram* or *asszonyom*.
